mapper.select: select count(*) as count, review_name, FLUX_MATCH_CD, review_dt from ( select s.document_id, s.flux_match_cd, d.document_type_code, to_char(s.REVIEW_DATE,'mm/dd/yyyy') as review_dt, review_date, n.first_name||' '||n.last_name as review_name from std_death_doc s,nyehms_users n, document_locator d where d.document_id = s.document_id and s.flux_match_cd in ('C_M','C_N') and trunc(s.REVIEW_DATE) between to_date(#{fromDate},'mm/dd/yyyy') and to_date(#{toDate},'mm/dd/yyyy') and s.review_uid = n.worker_id union select s.document_id, s.flux_match_cd, d.document_type_code, to_char(s.REVIEW_DATE,'mm/dd/yyyy') as review_dt, review_date, n.first_name||' '||n.last_name as review_name from std_ssdm_doc s,nyehms_users n, document_locator d where d.document_id = s.document_id and s.flux_match_cd in ('C_M','C_N') and trunc(s.REVIEW_DATE) between to_date(#{fromDate},'mm/dd/yyyy') and to_date(#{toDate},'mm/dd/yyyy') and s.review_uid = n.worker_id ) group by review_name, FLUX_MATCH_CD, review_dt order by (to_date(review_dt,'mm/dd/yyyy'))
